conditions.A: One fresh shared initial; no repairs.
conditions.B: blind_repair_1..3: previous own candidate and fixed generic blind feedback.
conditions.C: real_repair_1..3: previous own candidate and normalized actual immediately preceding compiler diagnostics.
conditions.C_placebo: placebo_repair_1..3: previous own candidate and a different problem/family genuine donor diagnostic payload.

prompt_text.initial:
Natural-language source statement:
{nl_statement}

Write a complete Lean 4 proof of the fixed theorem below.

Output only the complete Lean theorem in a Lean code block. Do not change the
theorem statement, add axioms, or use sorry, sorryAx, or admit.

Fixed theorem:
```lean
{theorem_statement}
```

Lean 4 syntax is mandatory: write `:= by` with indentation; never use Lean 3 `begin ... end` or comma-separated tactic blocks. For finite sums use `∑ k ∈ s, ...`, not `∑ k in s, ...`. Keep every binder and hypothesis exactly as given.

donor_scope: Only existing test shared-initial verification files, category and family; never reads repair outcomes or uses them to tune anything.
donor_rule: Exclude same problem or family; prefer same frozen primary error category; minimize absolute normalized diagnostic-payload token-count difference to own current diagnostic payload; ties by SHA256(donor_id + colon + payload_sha256). Fall back to any eligible real diagnostic and log fallback if category has no matches; stop if no eligible donor. Apply again at every repair.
normalization: Deep-copy diagnostics in original order. Only fileName metadata becomes resolved repository-relative POSIX path. All actual message data, severity, kind, locations and every other field remain equal. No non-filename private content is edited; stop if it cannot be exported unchanged. Compiler JSON serialization may change whitespace only after filename normalization.
seed_policy: sha256(base_seed:phase/seed/problem/step:prompt_sha256)_first_uint32; independent calls/KV and durable no-replay intents.
memory_schedule: Release model/tokenizer references and Metal allocator cache after each completion and before Lean; next call rehashes/reloads the identical model. Per-context seed and independent KV policy unchanged.
resident_memory: resource.getrusage(RUSAGE_SELF).ru_maxrss peak bytes (not instantaneous RSS) and native MLX peak_memory_gb when available.
stopping: Verified success, three completed/consumed repair intents, preflight failure, missing generation, no genuine C diagnostics, or verifier infrastructure failure. No truncation, synthetic diagnostics, generation replay, or replacement of incomplete output. Complete outputs/verifications may be reused by durable checkpoints.
proof_policy: Existing strict verifier, exact-type check and allowed axioms unmodified, timeout 180 seconds.
analysis_scope: Exploratory n=15 one-seed counts, Wilson intervals and process metrics; no hypothesis-test or proof-of-content-use claims.
interpretation: Findings may be consistent/inconsistent with diagnostic-content sensitivity; cannot prove use or nonuse. Donor matching itself reveals error category/length, and donor mathematical content can be indirectly helpful.
study2_execution: Deferred pending separate approval; no new held-out execution.
